design_informed_by: Previously inspected E04 full test and complete five-seed diagnostic; not prospective evidence for that same test.

data.site: WTB, same 134 nodes; no unregistered site substitution
data.calibration_role: Former E04 test is historical calibration for a strictly later new evaluation only
data.new_test_window: Prospective WTB days 246-280; actual source availability UNKNOWN
data.label_arrival_rule: All calibration target/quality labels must have actually arrived at least one 10-minute step before test start
data.feature_ingress: UnifiedArrivalDataset; historical scaler/fill only; pitch withheld; past ramp uses genuinely arrived power and masks
data.evaluation_mask: Same frozen target-valid AND offline anchor-regime-valid definition for every policy; true regimes never enter decisions

gates.primary_rule: For each of cost difference, violation difference, absolute violation, max(original U95, shared-day U95) <= original threshold

calibration.offset: max(0, percentile95 of historical day-block bootstrap Q0.90 scores)
calibration.reserve_rule: base_reserve + frozen_offset; never clip or tune after new test
calibration.groups: WR: original ten wind bins x past60 power ramp {down<-150, within[-150,150], up>150 kW}
calibration.empty_bootstrap_group: use its predeclared parent on that draw; if global empty, fail closed
calibration.coverage_theorem_claim: NONE for dependent/drifting WTB data; bootstrap offset is empirical, not a certified distribution-free guarantee

evaluation.primary_population: Full, all registered new issue indices and common mask
evaluation.primary_comparator: B0; never replace with B_WR for feasibility
evaluation.secondary_comparator_for_representation: C_WR/D_WR/D10_WR versus B_WR, same historical calibration and information
evaluation.shared_day_rule: resample 5 seeds, then same 35 native day-block indices for all selected seeds and policies
evaluation.cost_scale: retain E04 selector sum-over-sampled-seeds; report per-seed means separately
evaluation.diagnostic_sensitivity: 3/7-day shared circular blocks, seed 20261024, 20000 draws; cannot rescue primary failure
evaluation.secondary_selection_status: descriptive only; do not certify a selected secondary winner on the same new test

activation.new_test_availability: UNKNOWN; current cache ends before new test
required_before_test: bind common future cohort/collection specification without viewing outcomes
archive all base/calibration posteriors, edges, bin IDs, reserves and mature-label times
predeclare numeric profile before CUDA; exact archived-action n/violation/cost audit
freeze all offsets/support/fallbacks before opening new test outcomes
